description: This Java class 'EntityFindOptions' defines various options for advanced database entity finding operations, including result set type, concurrency, fetch size, limits, and offsets.

classes.name: EntityFindOptions
classes.description: A class encapsulating advanced options for entity find operations, including result set type, concurrency, fetch size, limits, and distinct filtering.

methods.name: EntityFindOptions
methods.description: Default constructor initializing default find options.

methods.name: EntityFindOptions
methods.description: Parameterized constructor to set all find options.

methods.name: getSpecifyTypeAndConcur
methods.description: Returns whether specific result set type and concurrency are used.

methods.name: setSpecifyTypeAndConcur
methods.description: Sets whether to specify result set type and concurrency.

methods.name: getResultSetType
methods.description: Returns the result set type used for the query.

methods.name: setResultSetType
methods.description: Sets the result set type for the query.

methods.name: getResultSetConcurrency
methods.description: Returns the concurrency mode for the result set.

methods.name: setResultSetConcurrency
methods.description: Sets the concurrency mode for the result set.

methods.name: getFetchSize
methods.description: Returns the fetch size for the query.

methods.name: setFetchSize
methods.description: Sets the fetch size for the query.

methods.name: getMaxRows
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of rows to retrieve.

methods.name: setMaxRows
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of rows to retrieve.

methods.name: getDistinct
methods.description: Returns whether duplicate filtering is enabled.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit on number of results.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets the limit on number of results.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset for result retrieval.

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset for result retrieval.
